core_obligations: Contrapositive: pick f in I mapping nonzero to I/mI but to zero in J/mJ.
Choose I' with mI subset I' subset I such that I/I' is generated by the image of f; set R = A/I, R' = A/I'.
Write J = (a_1, ..., a_m) and expand f = sum b_j a_j with b_j in m; transport to r_j, f_j in R and r'_j, f'_j in R'.
Verify the hypotheses of the obstruction lemma (with its ideal I taken to be m_R) and conclude.
proof_roadmap: Set up the contrapositive data and match them against the obstruction lemma.
